title: Session launching and tracking
summary: Wave 1 design foundation nearing completion. Session system design is explicit; downstream implementation graph ready for refinement.

nodes.title: Bootstrap design docs
nodes.summary: Create Streamliner's repo-scoped docs/design set from the current root docs and switch this workstream to reference that design layer.

nodes.title: Make workstream design explicit
nodes.summary: Run explicit design sessions for the full workstream so the launch contract, key design decisions, and downstream issue-graph adjustments are written down before more implementation issues are finalized.

nodes.title: Wave 1: design foundation aligned
nodes.summary: Repo-scoped design docs exist and the workstream's explicit design direction is clear enough to guide implementation without relying on implicit brief-or-graph assumptions.

nodes.title: Backend context assembly
nodes.summary: Assemble the Layer 0-3 launch payload on the backend per the session system design: read design docs, extract brief sections, resolve node specs, and write assembled context files to the PAW work directory.

nodes.title: Copilot SDK paw-init plumbing
nodes.summary: Use Copilot SDK on the backend to run paw-init in the target repo and prepare the PAW work directory before terminal launch.

nodes.title: Terminal launch integration
nodes.summary: Launch a visible terminal session from the graph so the operator can watch and intervene in the PAW session as needed.

nodes.title: Session state observation
nodes.summary: Implement the observation-based session tracking model defined in the session system design: watch Copilot session state files, detect turn boundaries from events.jsonl, process hook signal files, and bind sessions to graph nodes via launch claims.

nodes.title: Runtime overlay in UI
nodes.summary: Overlay live session heartbeat state and tracker snapshots onto the committed graph in the UI, combining committed node status with runtime session status per the overlay model in the session system design.

nodes.title: Launch and tracking usable
nodes.summary: A node can launch a PAW session into a visible terminal and Streamliner can show live runtime state for that node without committing telemetry into the workstream artifacts.

checkpoints.title: Design foundation aligned
checkpoints.summary: Repo-scoped design docs exist and the workstream's explicit design direction is captured.

checkpoints.title: Launch from graph works
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner assembles context, runs paw-init, and launches a visible terminal session from a node.

checkpoints.title: Tracking visible in UI
checkpoints.summary: Streamliner overlays runtime session and tracker state on the graph without turning graph.json into a telemetry log.
